targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfHour(occurred_at) AS time, sum(ifNull(JSONExtractFloat(payload_json, 'cost_usd'), 0)) AS cost_usd FROM events_v1 WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_type IN ('model.call.completed', 'media.render.completed') GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT project_id, JSONExtractString(payload_json, 'provider') AS provider, sum(ifNull(JSONExtractFloat(payload_json, 'cost_usd'), 0)) AS cost_usd, count() AS operations FROM events_v1 WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND event_type = 'model.call.completed' GROUP BY project_id, provider ORDER BY cost_usd DESC
